annotations.summary: EviMed metrics endpoint is unavailable
annotations.description: Prometheus has been unable to scrape the protected API metrics endpoint for two minutes.

annotations.summary: EviMed health probe is failing
annotations.description: The API liveness endpoint has failed from the monitoring network for two minutes.

annotations.summary: EviMed deployment is not ready
annotations.description: The readiness endpoint has returned a non-success response for five minutes.

annotations.summary: EviMed readiness sub-check is failing
annotations.description: Readiness check {{ $labels.check }} is failing with code {{ $labels.code }}.

annotations.summary: EviMed API has sustained server errors
annotations.description: The API has exceeded 0.05 server-error responses per second for ten minutes.

annotations.summary: EviMed API error ratio is high
annotations.description: More than 20 percent of API responses have been errors for fifteen minutes.

annotations.summary: EviMed rate limits are under pressure
annotations.description: More than 25 rate-limit or command-capacity rejections occurred in ten minutes.

annotations.summary: EviMed task queue is near capacity
annotations.description: The global task queue has remained above 80 percent of its configured limit.

annotations.summary: EviMed runtime capacity is near its limit
annotations.description: Attached and starting runtimes have remained above 80 percent of the global limit.

annotations.summary: A running runtime lacks quota monitoring
annotations.description: At least one attached runtime is not covered by the periodic project quota monitor.

annotations.summary: The recall index is up but not accepting what it is given
annotations.description: The memory index worker's last job failed for fifteen minutes. The index answers its own health endpoint from its own process, so this is the symptom of a wrong embedding model, a revoked embedding key or a vector width the collection refuses. Recall keeps working on the term matcher; new memories are not being indexed.

annotations.summary: Recall is answering without the index it is configured to use
annotations.description: Every recall for fifteen minutes fell back to term matching because the index could not answer. No memory is lost and nothing wrong is shown, but the deployment is paying for ranking it is not getting.

annotations.summary: The public TLS certificate expires in under three days.
annotations.description: probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry for {{ $labels.instance }} is under three days away. The certbot renewal timer has stopped renewing; check `systemctl status certbot.timer` and the last renewal log on the host.

annotations.summary: The production host has under 20 GB free.
annotations.description: A release build needs room for three images of which the runtime alone is ~4 GB. Run `node scripts/ops/release-retention.mjs` to drop superseded releases, then `docker image prune` for images this deployment no longer references.

annotations.summary: The production host has under 8 GB free.
annotations.description: Below this the Postgres volume and the run workspaces are at risk. Reclaim space now; see the disk section of the operations runbook.

annotations.summary: The production host has under 2 GB of memory available.
annotations.description: This host is shared with five other products and their image builds. On 2026-09-19 one build step reached 5.9 GB, the kernel's OOM killer fired, and EviMed was unreachable for about 70 minutes with nothing in this stack naming the cause. Check `free -h` and `docker stats --no-stream` on the host, and whether another product is building.

annotations.summary: The production host has under 1 GB of memory available.
annotations.description: The OOM killer is about to choose a victim, and it chooses by size — the runtime containers and Postgres are the largest things here. Stop whatever is building before it picks for you.

annotations.summary: More than half of EviMed runs are failing
annotations.description: Over the last hour more than half of at least four finished runs ended failed. The EviMed Runs dashboard breaks them down by capability and error code.

annotations.summary: The knowledge plugin has read nothing for an hour
annotations.description: No fetch of any source through any exit has read something (ok, not-modified or empty) for 60 minutes (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: Fewer than 95% of the first-tier sources are healthy
annotations.description: The P0 sources' health rate has been under 95% for two hours; the sources page names the unhealthy ones (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: One host answered the knowledge plugin with 429 more than ten times in an hour
annotations.description: The plugin pauses a host on every 429; more than ten in an hour means its spacing for that host is too tight (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: The knowledge plugin made more than 50 model calls in a day
annotations.description: The plugin's only model use is proposing selectors for list pages that drifted (plan 14.2, 14.10); over 50 in 24 hours means many lists broke at once or a proposal loop, and it spends the plugin's own key.

annotations.summary: The oldest owed frontier work is more than six hours old
annotations.description: An entry due, an item promoted and not published, an edit owed, or a source due in the plugin has waited more than six hours (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: Fewer than half the usual entries arrived in the last day
annotations.description: Entries inserted in the last 24 hours are below half of the same weekday a week earlier (plan 10.5.8's weekday and weekend baselines).

annotations.summary: Under 85% of the frontier edits pass the number check first time
annotations.description: More than 15% of the day's first edit answers carried a number the source does not have (plan 10.5.8's 复核一次通过率); edit_first_pass_failures_total names the other fields sent back.

annotations.summary: More than 5% of today's items were published title-only
annotations.description: Items whose edit failed the number check twice are published with their original title only (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: The frontier module has spent 80% of today's model budget
annotations.description: At the budget new entries are collected only and published items wait for their edit (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: Fewer than five items are selected by noon in Beijing
annotations.description: Between 12:00 and 24:00 Beijing time the day has fewer than five selected items (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: The knowledge plugin's Tokyo exit is failing
annotations.description: Every recent request through the relay exit failed for thirty minutes; the relay sources read nothing (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: The Tokyo proxy's certificate expires within a day
annotations.description: The node's IP certificate lives six days and renews twice a day, so under a day left means renewal has stopped (plan 10.5.8 said three days, written for an ordinary certificate).

annotations.summary: The frontier module has not pulled from the knowledge plugin for 30 minutes
annotations.description: No stream pull has succeeded for thirty minutes; readiness shows the plugin's state (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: The platform is more than 2,000 entries behind the knowledge plugin
annotations.description: The plugin's latest seq minus the platform's cursor has exceeded 2,000 (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: Today's frontier daily issue is missing past 07:45
annotations.description: The 07:30 issue has not been written by its alert time (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: The frontier pages' API answers slower than 300 ms at the 95th percentile
annotations.description: Reader routes under /api/frontier/ are slow; the 304 share is in open_science_frontier_http_answers_total (plan 10.5.8).

annotations.summary: 模型服务商 {{ $labels.provider }} 余额已用尽：对它的每一次调用都会失败，直到充值为止
annotations.description: 过去 10 分钟内 {{ $labels.provider }} 以「余额不足」拒绝了调用（DeepSeek 为 HTTP 402；DashScope 的欠费应答 400 Arrearage 也计在 402 下）。deepseek：所有研究运行、前沿动态、路由、标题与记忆提取都会失败；dashscope：独立审查、重排序与嵌入会失败；typesafe：回复核查全部改由审查模型判断。充值后下一次调用即恢复，无需重启；处置见运维手册 ModelProviderBalanceExhausted。

annotations.summary: More than half of the reviewer's editor passes failed in the last hour
annotations.description: Deliverables are still delivered and still get the deterministic checks, but no editor findings. /api/ready's review check names the last error (the key, the model, a timeout); see the runbook's reviewer section.

annotations.summary: Reply checks are failing more often than they finish
annotations.description: Cited answers are shown without their check row. The registries (Crossref, PubMed) or the reviewer model are the usual cause.

rules.expr: sum by (site) (increase(open_science_jev_requests_total{outcome="failed"}[1h])) >= 3 and sum by (site) (increase(open_science_jev_requests_total{outcome="failed"}[1h])) > sum by (site) (increase(open_science_jev_requests_total{outcome="answered"}[1h]))

annotations.summary: A registered Jev site is falling back repeatedly
annotations.description: Inspect its site state and control-plane provider refusals; fallback preserves the original path.

annotations.summary: An answer's medicine claim was contradicted by its own cited source
annotations.description: The researcher has been told in the inbox and, for a chat-started run, in the chat. Worth a look at the conversation: the reply check is in evimed_review.reply_checks.

annotations.summary: Jev agreement stayed below its calibrated baseline for seven UTC days
annotations.description: Review the model and prompt fingerprint before changing this site threshold.

annotations.summary: 数据源 {{ $labels.source }} 的部署密钥已配置却读不到：对它的每一次请求都被拒绝
annotations.description: 网关因凭据缺失拒绝了 {{ $labels.source }} 的请求，而部署为它配置过密钥文件或变量——文件权限、属组、符号链接或路径不对（/api/ready 的 publicSourceCredentials 写着具体错误码）。运行不会报错，只会悄悄改用别的来源：2026-09-22 起 EviMed 文献接口的密钥文件因属组权限读不到，三天里 325 次文献检索退回 PubMed，没有任何告警。修好文件后重启 web 容器即恢复。

annotations.summary: EviMed 自有证据接口在过去一小时被网关拒绝 {{ $value }} 次（没有可用的密钥）
annotations.description: 文献、指南、试验、专利、说明书检索都会先问 EviMed 接口，被拒后退回 PubMed 等公共源，并向模型说明该源未配置，报告质量可能下降而运行照常成功；部署没有密钥时，研究者可在「设置 → 数据源」自己添加。检查部署的 OPEN_SCIENCE_EVIMED_API_KEY_FILE（0440、属组与知识源插件共用）与 /api/ready 的 publicSourceCredentials；本部署若有意不接 EviMed 接口、由研究者自带密钥，静默此告警。

annotations.summary: 循证 GEO 有 {{ $value }} 条 S3/S4 级「讲错我方」尚未关闭
annotations.description: 消费级 AI 引擎在回答里讲错了客户的药品，且严重度为 S3 或 S4（可能影响用药安全）。在「循证 GEO → 准确与安全」处理或关闭；涉及临床安全的稿件已被 safety_stops 拦下（open_science_geo_safety_stops）。

annotations.summary: 循证 GEO 的探测循环超过 30 分钟没有成功跑完一轮
annotations.description: 探测循环每个基础节拍都会跑一次（没有到期的题目也算一次成功），所以半小时没有成功就是它卡住了（超过 OPEN_SCIENCE_GEO_LEASE_MS 仍在运行）或每次都在失败。/api/ready 的 geo.worker.loops.probe 写着 lastError；常见原因是探测主机不可达或 CDP 断开。可见度与准确度的数据会停在最后一轮。

annotations.summary: 循证 GEO 探测主机上有 {{ $value }} 个 AI 引擎被熔断暂停已超过一小时
annotations.description: 连续多次答回登录页、空壳或错误的引擎会被暂停，每十分钟复查一次；超过一小时仍暂停，基本是引擎在探测主机上被登出了（2026-09-26：DeepSeek 停在登录页、元宝与豆包无有效回答，只剩两个引擎在答）。在探测主机上重新登录对应标签页，熔断器会在十分钟内自行恢复；收件箱里有 geo_probe_engine_paused 通知写明是哪个引擎。

annotations.summary: The recall reranker fails more often than it succeeds
annotations.description: Recall still answers: the reranker fails open and the index's vector order stands, so nothing visible breaks. open_science_memory_rerank_total{code} names why — the DashScope key file, the account's balance, a timeout, or the pinned rerank model withdrawn; see the runbook row MemoryRerankFailing.
